hypothesis: For the exponential-family concern parameterisation of the 4-bit Boolean world with concern statistic T(x) = (2*x_0 - 1, 2*x_2 - 1), (a) the empirical Fisher information matrix on every fiber q^{-1}(z) matches the closed-form prediction g_{c,z} = beta^2 * diag(sech^2(beta c_1), sech^2(beta c_2)) at every point (c, z) in the pre-registered grid (Theorem CG-1); (b) the non-exact concern-1-form alpha + epsilon * (-c_2 dc_1) has holonomy epsilon along the unit rectangle in c-space and epsilon/2 along the unit triangle, both computed by trapezoidal quadrature on 500 steps per edge (Theorem CG-2 via Green's theorem).

gates.CFP_CG1_EMPIRICAL_FISHER_MATCHES_PREDICT: For every c in the 4-point concern grid and every z in {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)}, the maximum absolute difference between the empirical Fisher matrix (beta^2 * Cov[T]) and the closed form (beta^2 * diag(sech^2(beta c_i))) is below 1e-12.
gates.CFP_CG1_FISHER_IS_DIAGONAL_AT_EVERY_GRID: The off-diagonal entries of the empirical Fisher matrix are exactly zero at every grid point (independence of T_1 and T_2 under K_c(.|z)).
gates.CFP_CG2_RECTANGLE_HOLONOMY_MATCHES_AREA_: Holonomy of alpha + epsilon * (-c_2 dc_1) around the unit rectangle in c-space (area 1) matches epsilon = 0.3 to within 1e-3 (trapezoidal quadrature on 500 steps per edge).
gates.CFP_CG2_TRIANGLE_HOLONOMY_MATCHES_HALF_E: Holonomy around the (0,0)->(1,0)->(1,1)->(0,0) triangle (area 1/2) matches epsilon/2 = 0.15 to within 1e-3.

compute.sampling: exact enumeration of the 16-element Boolean world; closed-form Fisher matches; trapezoidal quadrature for the holonomy line integral
